scope_note: Targeted OEM primary-source checks of HCDW draft (hcdw_source.txt). Verifies OEM product names, features and availability only. Quadra partner tiers, AWS MSP Competency, certifications, SLAs and customer outcomes were NOT verified.

limitations: Bounded (~5 min) pass; 14 checks on high-risk claims, not exhaustive feature-by-feature validation.
Quadra partner tiers, AWS MSP Competency, 'certified depth', SLAs, BFSI/healthcare delivery claims and customer outcomes were not verified.
GA status per region, edition and deployment model (software, SaaS, appliance) was not confirmed for announced features; confirm with each OEM before publishing as available.
Commvault forest-level AD and Okta recovery, Druva BYOK and AD restore without DC restart, Commvault 3x TCO and Druva 40% claims were not located in primary sources in this pass.
Several product pages are undated living documents; marked 'undated' and should be rechecked before go-live.
Druva's AI Resilience overview page uses broader Claude wording than its Claude Backup FAQ; the narrower FAQ scope was adopted.
Vendor statements (frameworks count, 'first', '#1') are OEM claims, not independent validation; no analyst or customer evidence was reviewed.
